rules.statement: In cases governed by the Amended Kandyan Marriage Ordinance of 1870, the production of a diga marriage certificate is sufficient to prove that the wife forfeited her paternal inheritance.
rules.supporting_quote: "In cases governed by the Amended Kandyan Marriage Ordinance of 1870 the production of a diga marriage certificate is of itself sufficient to prove not only that the wife was married in diga but also that she forfeited her paternal inheritance"
